testcase.name: a new include gets ink appended unless the name ends with it
a new include name that cannot be a project path is refused
name and folder split a path at its last slash
an include that names nothing inside the project is no path
an include path is resolved against the root like a file system would
the end of a row is found for every kind of line break
the paths of INCLUDE lines are found without their comment and trailing blanks
an include path is read as the compiler reads it
the hash of a text is its SHA-256 in UTF-8
a path is root-relative with single slashes and no dot segments
an ink file is one whose text after the last dot is exactly ink
